description: This is a Java test class for integration testing the Loan API in the Apache Fineract project. It contains multiple test methods for various scenarios related to loan retrieval, disbursement, and summaries, primarily using JUnit 5 framework. The class extends BaseLoanIntegrationTest and interacts with client and loan helpers to set up test data, then performs assertions on API responses.

classes.name: LoanApiIntegrationTest
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class for integration testing the Loan API functionalities within the Fineract system.

methods.name: test_retrieveLoansByClientId_Works
methods.description: Tests retrieving loans by client ID and verifies the loan appears in the response.

methods.name: test_retrieveLoansWithSummary_Works
methods.description: Tests retrieving loan details with summary information and verifies the total unpaid payable due interest.

methods.name: test_retrieveLoansWithSummaryForMultipleLoans_Works
methods.description: Tests retrieving summaries for multiple loans belonging to a client.

methods.name: test_retrieveLoansWithSummaryWithoutDisbursement_Works
methods.description: Verifies behavior when retrieving loan summary without disbursement.
